name: DigiBi — Consultation Config Capture
description: Form to capture a client's AI-agent config during consultation; emails owner + client and saves the config as a task on the HubSpot deal.

parameters.formDescription: Fill this in during/after your consultation. It saves the agent config as a task on the client deal and emails you a copy.

values.placeholder: Must match the email on their HubSpot deal

values.fieldLabel: How the AI should greet callers

values.formSubmittedText: Saved — config written to the deal and emailed to you.

parameters.subject: =Consultation config: {{ $('Consultation Config Capture').item.json['Business name'] }}

parameters.subject: Please confirm your DigiBi setup details
parameters.html:
={{ '

Hi ' + $('Consultation Config Capture').item.json['Business name'] + ',

Thanks for your consultation! Here is the setup we have noted for your AI receptionist — please check it over:

  • Greeting: ' + $('Consultation Config Capture').item.json['How the AI should greet callers'] + '
  • Business hours: ' + $('Consultation Config Capture').item.json['Business hours'] + '
  • Services: ' + $('Consultation Config Capture').item.json['Services offered'] + '
  • Booking: ' + $('Consultation Config Capture').item.json['Booking rules or calendar'] + '
  • Common questions: ' + $('Consultation Config Capture').item.json['Common questions (FAQs)'] + '
  • Voice & tone: ' + $('Consultation Config Capture').item.json['Voice and tone'] + '

nodes.name: Email Config to Client
nodes.notes: Sends the captured config to the client to confirm it is correct and invites them to add FAQs.

nodes.name: Find Deal by Email
nodes.notes: Finds the client deal by digibi_contact_email. If none is found the task step is skipped but you still get the email copy.

metadata.subject: Build AI agent — config from consultation

nodes.name: Save Config Task on Deal
